name: Cache trim
description: Measures cache-like files in a folder you name (or a local cache directory) and proposes trimming the stale ones. Always previews the exact file list first (dry run) and only deletes after you approve.
approvalPrompt: FRIDAY wants to DELETE {count} cache file(s) ({size}) from “{folder}” older than {olderThanDays} days. This is permanent. Review the previewed list before allowing.
